text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A merciless reality lies ahead... Yet, 
there is no need to avert our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh... This is the prologue to 
Genesis! The story of how I destroy 
Babylon and bring its rebirth!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I can see it! A dramatic counterattack!! 
Future victory is in my grasp!!!!
choice_data_list: At this rate, you've got this in the bag.
At this rate, you'll definitely win.
Let's do our best so we can win next time!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I have no time for melancholy. 
I have only to keep turning the pages.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting, blinding radiance shall now be 
unleashed! Bear witness, spectators, and 
behold it with your own eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Through devotion, our flesh and 
blood ascend higher!! No matter how many 
futures unfold, victory shall be ours!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I shall carve my vivid deeds 
into history!!!!
